instruction: How to add a netem jitter (delay variation)
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 100ms 10ms 25%

instruction: How to add netem correlation for delay
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 100ms 20ms 75%

instruction: How to add netem loss with correlation
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 5% 50%

instruction: How to add netem gap loss pattern

instruction: How to add netem state loss pattern (4-state Markov)
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss state 10% 20% 30% 40%

instruction: How to add netem with packet duplication correlation
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem duplicate 2% 80%

instruction: How to add netem corruption correlation
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem corrupt 1% 50%

instruction: How to add netem reorder with correlation
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 100ms reorder 10% 50%

instruction: How to add netem with gap reordering

instruction: How to add netem for rate limiting
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem rate 100kbit

instruction: How to add netem with packet overhead

instruction: How to add netem to simulate cellular network
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 200ms 50ms loss 2% 25% rate 500kbit duplicate 1% reorder 5% 50%

instruction: How to add netem on a child qdisc for selective traffic
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: prio && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:3 handle 30: netem delay 300ms && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.0.0.5 flowid 1:3

instruction: How to remove all netem effects
output: tc qdisc del dev eth0 root

instruction: How to show netem statistics
output: tc -s qdisc show dev eth0 | tail -20

instruction: How to use tc with SSH traffic prioritization
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: prio && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dport 22 0xffff flowid 1:1

instruction: How to shape voice traffic (UDP 16384-32767)
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 512kbit ceil 1mbit && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 17 0xff match ip sport 16384 0xe000 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to use TBF with peakrate

instruction: How to save tc rules to a script
output: tc qdisc show dev eth0 > /root/tc-backup.sh && tc class show dev eth0 >> /root/tc-backup.sh && tc filter show dev eth0 >> /root/tc-backup.sh
